meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 3 — Electronics/computer exports (core of USA trade), energy mix, poverty/living standards, and major FTAs (CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP).

candidates.title: Electronics, computers and components trade statistics
candidates.description: Trade statistics for electronics, computers and components — the single largest and fastest-growing export category. Exports have more than tripled over the past decade; imports of components remain large, reflecting assembly-oriented participation in global value chains. Dominant in the Vietnam–US trade corridor.
candidates.notes: High-centrality commodity node linking industry, FDI and the USA export relationship.

candidates.title: Electricity generation and energy mix statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Industry and Trade / EVN / GSO related
candidates.description: Power generation and capacity by source. Coal remains a large share of total energy supply; hydropower, gas, solar and wind are expanding under successive Power Development Plans. Energy transition targets are progressively raising renewable shares.
referenced_by: National accounts and industrial energy demand
candidates.notes: Core energy-system node. Coal-heavy with rising renewables.

candidates.title: National Power Development Plan (PDP) framework
candidates.publisher: Government of Vietnam / Ministry of Industry and Trade
candidates.description: The successive National Power Development Plans (including PDP8 and adjustments) that set capacity targets, fuel mix trajectories and energy-transition pathways to 2030 and beyond.

candidates.title: Poverty and living standards survey statistics
candidates.description: Results from the Vietnam Household Living Standards Survey and related poverty-rate series. Multidimensional and income poverty have fallen sharply; remaining poverty is concentrated in northern mountainous and some ethnic-minority areas.

candidates.title: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) participation
candidates.description: Vietnam’s membership in CPTPP (in force 2019). Provides preferential access to a high-standard Pacific trade bloc and interacts with electronics, apparel and agricultural export patterns.

candidates.title: EU–Vietnam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA)
candidates.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and the European Union
candidates.description: Bilateral FTA with the European Union (in force 2020). Significant for apparel, footwear, agricultural and other exports to the EU market.

candidates.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) participation
candidates.description: Vietnam’s membership in RCEP. Links ASEAN with China, Japan, Korea, Australia and New Zealand and reinforces regional electronics and intermediate-goods value chains.

candidates.title: Vietnam FTA / EPA network overview
candidates.description: System-level view of Vietnam’s extensive FTA network (ASEAN, CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP, bilateral agreements with Japan, Korea, etc.). Organises the individual treaty nodes and underpins export diversification.

candidates.title: Vietnam electronics–energy–poverty–FTA densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO, energy and trade-policy sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding electronics/computer trade, energy mix and Power Development Plan, poverty/living-standards statistics, CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP and overall FTA network into a coherent value-chain, energy, welfare and trade-architecture layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
USA trade, IIP, FDI and national accounts from earlier batches
